name: g74_pass_sitrus_tie
purpose: Successful Baton Pass with a Sitrus speed tie on both sides (decision 0042 section 14, the Substitute update fix's pattern): Umbreon (M) on each side holds Sitrus Berry and has the same spread, so the two holders tie in speed. Umbreon (p1) uses Baton Pass on turn 1: the hit is true, so the Champions hit loop runs its two Updates (scripts.ts:537, :574) after the switch flag is set and before the switch request; the two Umbreon are still on the field then, so the tie is drawn. Espeon (M) enters as the first standing reserve.
